history.overview: The Ruined Shrines were once sacred Dragorn ceremonial sites, now desecrated and corrupted by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Shrine Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn artisans built shrines to honor noble lineage and ancestors.

timeline.name: Ceremonial Era
timeline.description: Shrines hosted rites of passage, ascension, and remembrance.

timeline.name: Muramite Desecration
timeline.description: Muramite forces destroyed the shrines during their invasion.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord fissures erupted, corrupting shrine stones and animating statues.
